name: The Iron Captain
description: The last officer of a ruined border garrison, sealed inside blackened plate and still enforcing orders no one remembers.

ai_profile.behavior: Press the nearest target with Measured Strike. Use Shield Bash to interrupt a target that has a ready skill; use Riposte after a marked target attacks.
ai_profile.telegraph: His standard drops, then the armor's furnace seams flare before each heavy strike.

phases.description: The Captain fights by the book, using measured blows to test the party's defenses.
With the garrison standard broken, he abandons formation and counters anyone who dares press him.
